newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.Africa's Alexkor to look beyond gems - Sigcau.
newsitem.headline: S.Africa's Alexkor to look beyond gems - Sigcau.

text.p: South Africa's state-owned Alexkor diamond mining concern, on the list for privatisation, will probably have to switch its focus to activities like ostrich farming, Public Enterprises Minister Stella Sigcau said on Monday.
She told a media briefing that restructuring of the parastatal would have to take into account its enormous importance as a provider of jobs in the Namaqualand region of the Northern Cape.
"There is the problem that diamonds won't be there forever and there is a need to change what are historically non-core activities, like ostrich farming, into core activities," Sigcau said.
"Alexkor requires access to fresh capital to fund exploration and development...It will have to look for partnerships," she said.
